discovery: Every Item 2.02 8-K for the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 issuers, filed in the event window; record every exclusion
universe: The 23 issuers with an accepted Milestone 1 event, no others -- see candidate_universe below

candidate_universe.note: Fixed by the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 events (config/m1-events.json); not sampled or discovered.

minimum_note: Deliberately minimal: this is a pilot slice to measure real review throughput, not a coverage target. Setting a higher number would recreate the same over-scoping pressure the original 100-event Milestone 1 target already showed was a mistake; see docs/M1-READINESS-ASSESSMENT.md, Target amendment.
selection: Enumerate before reading returns; no performance-based sampling
scope: Daily regular-session previous-close-anchored labels only; intraday events quarantined
acceptance: Engineering pilot to measure real solo-review throughput for the depth push; not evidence of predictive power

authorization.decision: Milestone 2 step 2, pilot scope: 2 prior quarters for the same 23 issuers, same full review standard as Milestone 1

relationship_to_milestone_1: A separate, parallel protocol. It does not amend, extend or touch config/pilot.json, the frozen 243-candidate membership, or any Milestone 1 record. Its event window (2025-06-01 to 2026-01-04) ends the day before Milestone 1's begins (2026-01-05), so the two candidate pools cannot overlap.
